verdict.rationale: Cognee ships an official MCP server that brings persistent memory to MCP-compatible assistants, explicitly naming Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue and Codex. Multiple off-the-shelf tools can therefore attach to the same Cognee memory instance. missing for 10: ChatGPT connectivity not documented, no explicit documentation of multiple assistants sharing one memory at once, no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect off-the-shelf assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to the same memory so every tool I use shares what it knows about me

citations.quote: Connect Cognee to MCP-compatible AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and Cline.
Cognee MCP brings persistent AI memory to your workflow through the Model Context Protocol.
You access them through MCP-compatible AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Desktop, Continue, Cline, and Codex.
